  182   # Sets the number of battler slots on each side of the field independently.
  183   # For "1v2" names, the first number is for the player's side and the second
  184   # number is for the opposing side.
  185   def setBattleMode(mode)
  186     @sideSizes =
  187       case mode
  188       when "triple", "3v3" then [3, 3]
  189       when "3v2"           then [3, 2]
  190       when "3v1"           then [3, 1]
  191       when "2v3"           then [2, 3]
  192       when "double", "2v2" then [2, 2]
  193       when "2v1"           then [2, 1]
  194       when "1v3"           then [1, 3]
  195       when "1v2"           then [1, 2]
  196       else                      [1, 1]   # Single, 1v1 (default)
  197       end
  198   end

  200   def singleBattle?
  201     return pbSideSize(0) == 1 && pbSideSize(1) == 1
  202   end
  203 
  204   def pbSideSize(index)
  205     return @sideSizes[index % 2]
  206   end
  207 
  208   def maxBattlerIndex
  209     return (pbSideSize(0) > pbSideSize(1)) ? (pbSideSize(0) - 1) * 2 : (pbSideSize(1) * 2) - 1
  210   end

  215   def pbPlayer; return @player[0]; end

  217   # Given a battler index, returns the index within @player/@opponent of the
  218   # trainer that controls that battler index.
  219   # NOTE: You shouldn't ever have more trainers on a side than there are battler
  220   #       positions on that side. This method doesn't account for if you do.
  221   def pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
  222     trainer = (opposes?(idxBattler)) ? @opponent : @player
  223     return 0 if !trainer
  224     case trainer.length
  225     when 2
  226       n = pbSideSize(idxBattler % 2)
  227       return [0, 0, 1][idxBattler / 2] if n == 3
  228       return idxBattler / 2   # Same as [0,1][idxBattler/2], i.e. 2 battler slots
  229     when 3
  230       return idxBattler / 2
  231     end
  232     return 0
  233   end
  234 
  235   def pbGetOwnerFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
  236     idxTrainer = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
  237     trainer = (opposes?(idxBattler)) ? @opponent : @player
  238     return (trainer.nil?) ? nil : trainer[idxTrainer]
  239   end

  241   def pbGetOwnerIndexFromPartyIndex(idxBattler, idxParty)
  242     ret = -1
  243     pbPartyStarts(idxBattler).each_with_index do |start, i|
  244       break if start > idxParty
  245       ret = i
  246     end
  247     return ret
  248   end
  249 
  250   # Only used for the purpose of an error message when one trainer tries to
  251   # switch another trainer's Pokémon.
  252   def pbGetOwnerFromPartyIndex(idxBattler, idxParty)
  253     idxTrainer = pbGetOwnerIndexFromPartyIndex(idxBattler, idxParty)
  254     trainer = (opposes?(idxBattler)) ? @opponent : @player
  255     return (trainer.nil?) ? nil : trainer[idxTrainer]
  256   end

  258   def pbGetOwnerName(idxBattler)
  259     idxTrainer = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
  260     return @opponent[idxTrainer].full_name if opposes?(idxBattler)   # Opponent
  261     return @player[idxTrainer].full_name if idxTrainer > 0   # Ally trainer
  262     return @player[idxTrainer].name   # Player
  263   end

  265   def pbGetOwnerItems(idxBattler)
  266     if opposes?(idxBattler)
  267       return [] if !@items
  268       return @items[pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)]
  269     end
  270     return [] if !@ally_items
  271     return @ally_items[pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)]

  274   # Returns whether the battler in position idxBattler is owned by the same
  275   # trainer that owns the Pokémon in party slot idxParty. This assumes that
  276   # both the battler position and the party slot are from the same side.
  277   def pbIsOwner?(idxBattler, idxParty)
  278     idxTrainer1 = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
  279     idxTrainer2 = pbGetOwnerIndexFromPartyIndex(idxBattler, idxParty)
  280     return idxTrainer1 == idxTrainer2
  281   end

  283   def pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler)
  284     return false if opposes?(idxBattler)
  285     return pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler) == 0
  286   end

  288   # Returns the number of Pokémon positions controlled by the given trainerIndex
  289   # on the given side of battle.
  290   def pbNumPositions(side, idxTrainer)
  291     ret = 0
  292     pbSideSize(side).times do |i|
  293       t = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex((i * 2) + side)
  294       next if t != idxTrainer
  295       ret += 1
  296     end
  297     return ret
  298   end

  319   # Returns the player's team in its display order. Used when showing the party
  320   # screen.
  321   def pbPlayerDisplayParty(idxBattler = 0)
  322     partyOrders = pbPartyOrder(idxBattler)
  323     idxStart, _idxEnd = pbTeamIndexRangeFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
  324     ret = []
  325     eachInTeamFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler) { |pkmn, i| ret[partyOrders[i] - idxStart] = pkmn }
  326     return ret
  327   end

  329   def pbAbleCount(idxBattler = 0)
  330     party = pbParty(idxBattler)
  331     count = 0
  332     party.each { |pkmn| count += 1 if pkmn&.able? }
  333     return count
  334   end

  336   def pbAbleNonActiveCount(idxBattler = 0)
  337     party = pbParty(idxBattler)
  338     inBattleIndices = allSameSideBattlers(idxBattler).map { |b| b.pokemonIndex }
  339     count = 0
  340     party.each_with_index do |pkmn, idxParty|
  341       next if !pkmn || !pkmn.able?
  342       next if inBattleIndices.include?(idxParty)
  343       count += 1
  344     end
  345     return count
  346   end

  348   def pbAllFainted?(idxBattler = 0)

  352   def pbTeamAbleNonActiveCount(idxBattler = 0)
  353     inBattleIndices = allSameSideBattlers(idxBattler).map { |b| b.pokemonIndex }
  354     count = 0
  355     eachInTeamFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler) do |pkmn, i|
  356       next if !pkmn || !pkmn.able?
  357       next if inBattleIndices.include?(i)
  358       count += 1
  359     end
  360     return count
  361   end

  363   # For the given side of the field (0=player's, 1=opponent's), returns an array
  364   # containing the number of able Pokémon in each team.
  365   def pbAbleTeamCounts(side)
  366     party = pbParty(side)
  367     partyStarts = pbPartyStarts(side)
  368     ret = []
  369     idxTeam = -1
  370     nextStart = 0
  371     party.each_with_index do |pkmn, i|
  372       if i >= nextStart
  373         idxTeam += 1
  374         nextStart = (idxTeam < partyStarts.length - 1) ? partyStarts[idxTeam + 1] : party.length
  375       end
  376       next if !pkmn || !pkmn.able?
  377       ret[idxTeam] = 0 if !ret[idxTeam]
  378       ret[idxTeam] += 1
  379     end
  380     return ret
  381   end

  383   #=============================================================================
  384   # Get team information (a team is only the Pokémon owned by a particular
  385   # trainer)
  386   #=============================================================================
  387   def pbTeamIndexRangeFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
  388     partyStarts = pbPartyStarts(idxBattler)
  389     idxTrainer = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
  390     idxPartyStart = partyStarts[idxTrainer]
  391     idxPartyEnd   = (idxTrainer < partyStarts.length - 1) ? partyStarts[idxTrainer + 1] : pbParty(idxBattler).length
  392     return idxPartyStart, idxPartyEnd
  393   end
  394 
  395   def pbTeamLengthFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
  396     idxPartyStart, idxPartyEnd = pbTeamIndexRangeFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
  397     return idxPartyEnd - idxPartyStart
  398   end
